items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And he had a group there too, but he wasn't with Mamie Smith when they first came to Chicago. ... oh, Harvey Brooks. Yeah, a good piano player, Harvey Brooks.

ctx.x: And he had a group there too, but he wasn't with Mamie Smith when they first came to Chicago. The first one was this fellow that (unintelligible) boy of from Philadelphia name -- I think he still lives there too. Tall fellow, I can't call his name right off -- there, oh, Harvey Brooks.
